reviews.text:
⭐ 1 star — Paid twice. Got nothing. Asked to pay AGAIN.

I actually signed up reluctantly because my mum wanted to watch some of Shortical’s content. It seemed a bit dodgy from the start, but I thought, fine, let’s give it a go. Turns out my first impression was right.

I was charged R$45.91 twice within 27 minutes for Shortical. Same card, same email. R$91.82 in total.

And what did I receive for that?

Nothing.

So in other words,  I paid for a year of VIP benefits in July 2025 but will probably be screwed out of nine months worth of benefits  because I highly doubt Shortical will fix the problem before my benefits expire in July 2026.

reviews.title: Disappointed, no search, no library
reviews.text: I really had high hopes for this app.I believe their contact is very good. However, there is no search capability. And aside from the slider slideshow, there is no access to whatever library or back catalog they have. because there was no search you were stuck with a four or five verticals there are perform promoting. Or taking whatever there for you recommendations, they have decided for you. It’s really disappointing that I spent the money that I did only to be faced with such limitations. The lack of searches on me. I should’ve checked that out before I purchased. But the fact that you can’t get to the back catalog or library is a total waste of money. Why would you pay for unlimited viewing when the viewing is entirely limited?

reviews.title: Really upset
reviews.text: I bought a week subscription and the movies kept freezing up. I didn’t even get to get through one whole movie without it freezing up after several conversations with the company they couldn’t figure it out and they stopped responding. I wanted to have them make good on at least giving me a free week if I could figure out on my own, what was going wrong and I never heard from them again, so I wasted my money. I contacted them four times after that and never heard back from them. What a waste this company is.
